# Doodle AI

> Doodle AI is a conversational creative studio at https://doodleai.art that turns photos and ideas into playful, hand-drawn doodle avatars, collages, sticker sheets, mood captions, and gifts.

## Product
- Sign in with Google to upload, generate, save, and sync work. Browsing is open; creation requires an account.
- New accounts receive a 5-credit signup grant. Each generation costs 1 credit. Failed generations are refunded.
- Users do not enter a PicX API key. Generation uses Doodle AI's server-owned PicX connection.
- Saved characters can be mentioned with @. Signed-in chats, characters, and moodboards sync across devices.

## Skills
- [Doodle Avatar](https://doodleai.art/skills/normal/): One hand-drawn doodle avatar from your photo
- [Doodle Collage](https://doodleai.art/skills/collage/): Six close-up doodle poses in one 3x2 grid
- [Full-Body Action Collage](https://doodleai.art/skills/full-body/): Six full-body action poses in one 3x2 grid
- [Surprise Me](https://doodleai.art/skills/surprise/): No photo needed — a random fictional doodle character
- [Sticker Pack](https://doodleai.art/skills/stickers/): Die-cut sticker sheets from your doodles
- [Mood Captions](https://doodleai.art/skills/mood-captions/): Shareable doodle moods with hand-lettered captions
- [Gift Doodle](https://doodleai.art/skills/gift/): A hand-drawn greeting or gift image from your photo
- [Pet Portrait](https://doodleai.art/skills/pet/): Your pet, illustrated exactly as they are
- [Chibi Mini-Me](https://doodleai.art/skills/mini-me/): Tiny cartoon versions of you doodled over your real photo
- [Couple Doodle](https://doodleai.art/skills/couple/): Turn a photo of two people into one illustrated couple portrait
- [Crayon Self](https://doodleai.art/skills/crayon/): A 4-year-old drew you (on purpose)
- [Faceless Portrait](https://doodleai.art/skills/faceless/): A portrait that carries identity without a face
- [Seasonal Pack](https://doodleai.art/skills/seasonal/): Holiday and seasonal doodle collage themes
- [Emotional Modes](https://doodleai.art/skills/moods/): Mood-driven doodle variations — cozy, chaotic, dreamy
- [Expression Pack](https://doodleai.art/skills/expressions/): Expressive doodle reaction faces from your photo

## Technical flow
1. The signed-in browser sends a chat turn to `/api/chat`.
2. Photos are uploaded through `/api/upload` to PicX managed assets using the server-owned connection.
3. The Mastra agent selects a skill and calls the generation tool.
4. The tool reserves account credits, calls PicX, refunds failed attempts, and streams the result back as NDJSON events.
5. The browser renders the result. The user can save it to a moodboard or download it.

## Important boundaries
- Doodle AI is an Astro 5 application deployed to Cloudflare Workers.
- Better Auth sessions and Cloudflare D1/KV back the account and credit experience.
- Provider credentials remain server-side and are never accepted from the browser.
- User images are processed through PicX managed assets and generated media is hosted by PicX.
- Stripe checkout is not implemented. There is no paid credit pack yet.
- API routes, account settings, characters, moodboards, and private chats should not be treated as public documentation.
- Doodle AI is not doodleai.fun, InstaDoodle, LazyAvatar, or cartoonize.ai.

Long-form guides live at keyword-first root URLs, not under a /blog/ prefix.
- [How to turn a photo into a cartoon](https://doodleai.art/photo-to-cartoon/) — the four-step process on the Doodle Avatar skill.
- [Cartoon profile pictures from a photo](https://doodleai.art/cartoon-profile-picture/) — square PFPs, crop guidance, identity limits.
- [What an AI cartoon generator actually does](https://doodleai.art/ai-cartoon-generator/) — photo-to-cartoon vs text-to-image vs animation vs video.
- [Hand-drawn doodle prompt library](https://doodleai.art/ai-cartoon-generator/prompts/) — prompt patterns mapped to the runnable skills.
- [How to make a cartoon pet portrait](https://doodleai.art/cartoon-pet-portrait/) — dog, cat, and other pet photos as digital keepsakes.
- [Photo to sticker: sheets vs print vs chat apps](https://doodleai.art/photo-to-sticker/) — what the die-cut sheet image is and is not.
- [Personalized digital doodle gifts](https://doodleai.art/doodle-gift/) — digital occasion images; nothing is printed or shipped.
- [Mood-caption collages from one photo](https://doodleai.art/mood-caption-collage/) — the 3:2 captioned grid and its lettering limits.
- [For studios and filmmakers](https://doodleai.art/for-studios/) — stills-first production workflows.
- [Animation concept sprint](https://doodleai.art/for-studios/animation-concept-sprint/) — brief to reviewable concept board.
- [AI filmmaker pre-production stills](https://doodleai.art/for-studios/ai-filmmaker-stills/) — character and pose work before choosing a video approach.
